explanation.ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** مصطلح MTBF يعني متوسط الزمن بين الانهيارات (Mean Time Between Failures) في الأنظمة القابلة للإصلاح.
explanation.en: MTBF stands for Mean Time Between Failures. It represents the average elapsed operational time separating successive system failures in repairable systems, calculated as the sum of Mean Time To Failure (MTTF) and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR): $$MTBF = MTTF + MTTR$$

explanation.ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** هدف CMM الأساسي هو تحسين نضج العملية البرمجية للمؤسسة (Improve the software process)، وليس توليد كود آلياً.
explanation.en: The Capability Maturity Model (SEI CMM) is an organizational framework designed specifically to assess the maturity of software processes and guide organizations through evolutionary stages of software process improvement. It does not automatically generate source code or function as an automated testing engine.

explanation.ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** مستويات CMM الخمسة بالترتيب: 1- Initial ← 2- Repeatable ← 3- Defined ← 4- Managed ← 5- Optimizing.
explanation.en: The SEI Capability Maturity Model defines exactly five evolutionary maturity levels: 1. Level 1 — Initial: Chaotic, ad-hoc performance. 2. Level 2 — Repeatable: Basic project management controls. 3. Level 3 — Defined: Standardized, institutionalized engineering processes. 4. Level 4 — Managed: Quantitative process measurement and product quality metrics. 5. Level 5 — Optimizing: Continuous process improvement through feedback and technological innovation.

explanation.ar: والفخ الامتحاني:** فخ امتحاني شهير: اعتمادية النظام تعتمد حصراً على عدد الأخطاء المتبقية (Remaining) في الكود أثناء التشغيل، ولا تعتمد على عدد الأخطاء التي تم إصلاحها في الماضي.
explanation.en: Software reliability is determined strictly by the latent faults currently remaining in the code that can be encountered during execution, combined with the frequency of their activation under the operational profile. The historical count of faults removed during past debugging sessions does not dictate current system stability; a system from which 1,000 faults were removed may still fail immediately if critical residual faults remain in frequently executed pathways.

explanation.en: Dynamic software reliability models (such as Musa's models and Jelinski–Moranda) require executing the software under an operational profile and collecting dynamic failure timestamps and counts. Consequently, statistical estimation and measurement of software reliability take place primarily during system and integration testing, once an executable system exists.

explanation.en: Level 2 (Repeatable) of the Capability Maturity Model establishes fundamental project management controls, focusing on project planning, requirements management, project tracking, subcontract management, quality assurance, and configuration management to ensure realistic commitments based on past project successes.

explanation.en: At Level 3 (Defined), standard software engineering and management processes are documented, standardized, and integrated into an organization-wide standard software process (institutional process management). Projects tailor these standard organizational processes to develop approved, managed project processes.

explanation.en: The Capability Maturity Model (CMM) provides a structured metric and staging framework specifically designed to evaluate organizational process capability and track continuous process improvement. ISO 9126 measures product quality, ISO 9000 is a baseline certification standard, and the Spiral model is a life-cycle methodology.
